boundary.description: From the junction of Rocky Lane and Chorlton Fold, E along Folly Brook to the border of Eccles College then by a beeline SW to Ellesmere Road (excluding Godolphin Close and Welbeck Road – both in Ss Peter and Paul parish). SW along Ellesmere Road, E along Victoria Crescent, Half Edge Lane, Eccles Old Road, Stott Lane to its junction with Eccles New Road. Then by a beeline SW to the roundabout joining Coronet Way and Centenary Way, S along Centenary Way and W by Manchester Ship Canal to the point opposite Ashbourne Road. Then NW by a beeline to the junction of Ashbourne Road and Barton Lane, and W along Barton Lane. N along Fairless Road, Trafford Road, Renshae Avenue, Mellor Street (excluding both sides), Liverpool Road, Green Lane, Canal Bank, Bridgewater Way and by a beeline to Folly Brook and E along Folly Brook to the junction of Rocky Lane and Chorlton Fold.
